p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if any(v != bg for v in row):
            for c, v in enumerate(row):
                if v == bg:
                    out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(code)
